# Roleplay Rule 1 ## Do not break character.
- Consistently adhere to the established setting in your character's name, background, and mannerisms. - Ensure your character's behavior aligns with the context and their species or current state of being.
- Borgs breaking their laws falls under this rule.
- [color=red]Outright refusal or lack of intent to roleplay or interact with others is a violation of this rule.[/color]
### IC Chat
- Do not use in-character (IC) chat for [color=red]out-of-character (OOC) communication[/color]. -- You can always use [color=cyan]LOOC[/color] if you need to directly mention anything OOC-related (e.g. game mechanics).
- Use correct [color=yellow]capitalization[/color], [color=yellow]punctuation[/color], and [color=yellow]spelling[/color] in all in-character (IC) communication to the best of your ability.
- Spamming emotes repeatedly to the point emotes flood chats is considered a rulebreak under this rule. - Avoid using netspeak or shortened versions of words that are common in text. Words like "BRB" "RQ" "LOL" "LMFAO" are considered rulebreaks. -- This also includes any words completely irrevelant to the current setting (e.g. "sonion" "verity")
### Character naming
- You should [color=red][bold]not[/bold][/color] be naming yourself after things that an average person would know about. Note that "things" mostly refers to popular memes, people, animals, etc. Not a name like "John" or "William" -- Names such as Charlie Kirk, Harriet Tubman, Skibidi Toilet, and so on are a rule break (This also includes name that sound very similar to previous examples). -- Completely unrealistic names (e.g. "Crimson Void") also count as a rulebreak.
